2.source: relic set 301 (太空封印站 / Space Sealing Station), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's ATK by #1[i]%. When the wearer's SPD is equal to or higher than #2[i], the wearer's ATK increases by an extra #3[i]%." param = [0.12, 120, 0.12]
2.note: ⚠ Only the SECOND sentence is here. The first ("ATK +12%") is an unconditional stat and is already applied by RelicSuit from the effect's `properties` (AttackAddedRatio 0.12) -- writing it here as well would double it. This is the shape of every planar-ornament 2-piece: a stat, then a conditional extra, and only the conditional half is a rule. `self_attr:SPEED` reads the wearer's built sheet, which already includes every other equipped piece, so the threshold is judged against the real number. ⚠ APPROXIMATION: the text says "when the wearer's SPD is >= 120", i.e. continuously, whereas this is evaluated once at BATTLE_START. The engine has no "an attribute changed" event, and re-applying on TURN_START would STACK a permanent modifier every turn. Since SPD at battle start is what decides these ornament thresholds in practice, one evaluation is the honest choice; it is recorded here rather than left implicit.
